verdicts.reason: A is a real left-to-right banner with brand, bottle, headline, then CTA, but it is cramped. The bottle almost touches the top and bottom edges, the stacked decorative circles crowd the 'z' of the headline at the right edge, the body copy wraps into three ragged centred lines, and the oversized CTA nearly hits the right edge. B is broken: the headline and body copy sit directly on top of the bottle, which makes both hard to read. The SOLSTICE wordmark is tiny and jammed against the top edge, the text is undersized for the canvas, the CTA floats on its own in the middle, and the right third is mostly empty apart from scattered circles.
